title: Kenji's CSV Parser
statement:
Kenji is building a robust CSV data importer for his financial analytics engine. In standard CSV, fields are separated by commas. However, if a field contains commas or quotes, the entire field is surrounded by double quotes. Inside a quoted field, a literal quote is represented by two consecutive double quotes ("").

Given N lines of CSV records, parse each record into its individual fields and output the number of fields followed by each field enclosed in brackets [...].
input_format: The first line contains an integer N (1 <= N <= 100). The next N lines each contain a single CSV line string.
output_format: For each record, output the count of fields followed by each field enclosed in brackets [field].
